versions.content: Control of Operations Description: Diagnostics in AUTOSAR shall support the "‘API Methods for Control of Operations"‘. The following limitations in Operation capabilities related to SOVD methods: I/O control adjustments are not supported for the SOVD server in Adaptive Platforms, as the UDS service for I/O control is also not supported, yet. Rationale: Essential part of the SOVD protocol AppliesTo: AP Dependencies: – Use Case: Remote procedure calls and adjustment of values
